description: 2 x AA battery holder (box or pack, cells in series, 3 V) on wire leads: two plated holes for its red (+, VBAT) and black (−, GND) wires

datasheet.revision: Energizer E91 (AA alkaline) product datasheet: 1.5 V nominal, 0.8 V cut-off

pins.name: VBAT
pins.description: the pack's positive (red wire), 3 V nominal with fresh alkaline cells

notes: 2 alkaline AA cells in series: 3 V nominal, 3.3 V fresh, about 1.8 V empty; NiMH cells give 2.4 V. Choose the regulator for the whole range (a boost or buck-boost converter, or an LDO with low dropout).
Pass the wires through a strain-relief hole or tie them down; mark + and − on the silkscreen (the footprint prints them).

pins.source: the holder's leads (red +, black −) by the usual colour code; cell voltages from Energizer's E91 datasheet
pins.license: voltages (facts); footprint, descriptions and notes our own

footprint.note: wire pads of our own: 1.1 mm holes, 2.2 mm pads, 3.81 mm apart
